## Problem

What user problem or regression risk would this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful interface and its expected output.

## Scope and safety

Explain whether the proposal touches transport execution, tool side effects, secrets, or evidence formats. Identify any explicit opt-in required.

## Verification

Describe a deterministic fixture or test that would prove the behavior works.
